THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS PROPOSES APPROVAL OF A MAXIMUM TOTAL COMPENSATION OF CHF 21.0 MILLION FOR THE MEMBERS OF GROUP MANAGEMENT FOR THE 2027 FINANCIAL YEAR. THE PROPOSED MAXIMUM TOTAL COMPENSATION FOR THE MEMBERS OF GROUP MANAGEMENT FOR THE 2027 FINANCIAL YEAR IS UNCHANGED COMPARED TO THE PREVIOUS YEAR AND REMAINS CHF 21.0 MILLION (PREVIOUS YEAR: CHF 21.0 MILLION). THE AMOUNT IS BASED ON THE ASSUMPTION THAT THE SIZE AND COMPOSITION OF GROUP MANAGEMENT AND THE ALLOCATION OF TASKS WITHIN THE BODY REMAIN UNCHANGED. THE COMPENSATION OF THE MEMBERS OF GROUP MANAGEMENT IS BASED ON THEIR RESPECTIVE TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES AND CONSISTS OF A FIXED COMPENSATION, A SHORT-TERM PERFORMANCE-RELATED COMPENSATION, AND A LONG-TERM PERFORMANCE-RELATED COMPENSATION IN THE FORM OF OPTIONS ON PARTICIPATION CERTIFICATES. THE FIXED COMPENSATION REFLECTS THE RESPECTIVE FUNCTIONAL LEVEL, COMPETENCIES, EXPERTISE, AND EXPERIENCE AS WELL AS THE FUNDAMENTALLY EXPECTED SUSTAINABLE PERFORMANCE OF EACH MEMBER OF GROUP MANAGEMENT. IN ADDITION, THE MEMBERS OF GROUP MANAGEMENT RECEIVE ALLOWANCES AND OTHER FRINGE BENEFITS THAT ARE BASED ON MARKET PRACTICE AND ARE COMPETITIVE. THESE INCLUDE ENTITLEMENT TO A COMPANY CAR AND PARTICIPATION IN THE COMPANY'S PENSION PLANS. THE MAXIMUM AMOUNT TO BE APPROVED BY THE GENERAL MEETING MUST COVER ALL ELEMENTS OF THE COMPENSATION OF GROUP MANAGEMENT, WITH REGARD TO PERFORMANCE-RELATED COMPENSATION UNDER THE ASSUMPTION OF THE MAXIMUM EXPECTED ACHIEVEMENT OF ALL COMPANY AND INDIVIDUAL GOALS. AGAINST THIS BACKGROUND, THE PROPOSED AMOUNT IS INTENDED TO ENSURE THAT, DEPENDING ON THE COMPANY'S SUCCESS, SUFFICIENT FUNDS ARE AVAILABLE FOR THE ALLOCATION OF LONG-TERM COMPENSATION TO FULFILL THE MAXIMUM EXPECTED TOTAL COMPENSATION.
